notes: Every civilian now has their own skin tone, outfit, hair and build
Guards and heavies vary: helmets, caps, antennas, trim colours and body size
Multiplayer: other players now appear in the look they created
AI characters now appear as full-body holograms (first embedded 3D model; real human models come next)
New look for every menu and the HUD: red data panels, cyan selection, yellow quest markers; a square minimap with a clock, a quest tracker and Cyberpunk-style subtitles
New character creator: eight backgrounds with real strengths, drawbacks, combos and a five-part story each; full appearance editor (skin tone, hair, eyes, cyberware)
Old saves ask once: keep your character or remake it — all progress is kept
Skip Ahead [TAB] in scenes; Credits on the title screen
First-person hands on every gun and blade, in your jacket colour
Knife and melee swing animations with a slash trail
Kills hit harder: bodies fly with the shot, headshots snap back, a beat of hit-stop
New medkit model
New heavy weapons: Ghostbreaker Minigun (spins up), Rust Harbor Rail Cannon, Sector 9 Thumper, Iron Angel Breacher Shotcannon
Guns have real magazines: when they run dry they click — reload with R (Select on a controller, RELOAD on touch)
Recoil kicks the view up and now settles back to where you were aiming
Fast travel removed
SKIP SCENE button (or Tab) fast-forwards dialogue to the next choice or gameplay
Characters now match their dialogue portraits; brighter jacket colours, and the courier profile screen fits on phones
Every gun now has a sight: red dots on pistols, holo sights on SMGs and shotguns, a 2.5× scope on rifles and a 6× scope on precision rifles
Right-click (LT) to aim down sights: the gun swings up to your eye, scopes close in to a lens view; aiming tightens your shots — hold Shift to steady a scope
New hacking: ICE BREAK — pick codes along alternating rows and columns to upload the sequence before the trace runs out

Cutscenes overhauled: characters face each other and the camera films them like a movie — over-the-shoulder shots and close-ups that cut on each speaker, two-shots and establishing shots for narration
Story dialogue in cutscenes is shown as subtitles in the letterbox; the camera eases in and out of first person
No more random vehicles, billboards and props popping up during story scenes; the camera frames around walls and street poles
The game now asks which language you use the first time you start it (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文); change it any time in Settings
Title menu no longer shows a scrollbar; sign-in screens tidied
Free accounts: sign up with email, username and password; friends, co-op invites and cloud saves
Without an account you get a 2-chapter demo; multiplayer needs an account
Full Chinese translation (Simplified and Traditional)
Continue resumes at the exact line and spot you quit from
NPCs can be hit; weapon panel hides when you have no weapon or are in dialogue
Multiplayer is co-op only
New version alerts with this change log
